{{Quote|I am Darth Serevin, right hand to Emperor Malgus, emissary and friend to the Voss.|Darth Serevin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Darth Serevin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and would later join the [[New Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Darth Malgus]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I bear no shame. The galaxy is evolving, and I have marked my place among a new Empire.|Darth Serevin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Cultured, diplomatic, and charming, Darth Serevin was as concerned with appearance and manners as he was with seeking power. He once destroyed a former apprentice, not for his clumsy scheming and attempts at betrayal, but for insulting one of Serevin's dinner guests. For these reasons, when the Empire was still smoothing over its short-lived attempt at invading [[Voss]] and a diplomatic envoy of immense skill was called for, Darth Serevin's poise and experience made him the ideal choice. He was also a close ally of [[Darth Malgus]].

During his long tenure on Voss, Darth Serevin developed an appreciation for Voss art and architecture; so much so that he sent orders for his own lodgings on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to be redecorated accordingly. He also came to see the potential value of the Voss people to the Empire; and of gaining an army of [[Voss commandos]] and [[Voss Mystics]].

When Malgus revealed his plans for establishing a [[New Empire|new empire]], Serevin was among the many to flock to his ranks. He agreed with Malgus's beliefs that the Empire should not discriminate against alien species, such as the Voss. When an assembled strike team arrived to stop Malgus's forces from taking crystals for his stealth fleet, Serevin was present with two other Voss. One was a Mystic named [[Talsa-ko]], who stated that her vision detailed that she would side with the victor. If he won the battle, Serevin believed, the Voss would join the new empire. However, Serevin was ultimately killed by the strike force, and the Voss were either imprisoned or killed.

==Personality and traits==
Darth Serevin was a charming character, able to gain the trust of the Voss not only for the Empire, but for himself as well. Though appearing an exceptional diplomat, he also fooled the Voss, as he made them believe that an agent of the Empire was the one who would fulfill a new vision of theirs. He was one of the few Sith who disagreed with the Empire's anti-alien policies, which was one of the main reasons he joined Darth Malgus. In fact, he had developed a deep passion for alien art, especially the Voss. Serevin appeared to be one of the few Sith who preferred manners over their natural aggressiveness.

==Powers and abilities==
Like many of his fellow Sith Lords who had gained the Darth title, Serevin was an exceptional fighter, both in lightsaber combat and in the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He was able to hold his own against a strike team, displaying both his deadly lightsaber and his mastery of the Force. He proved to be a user of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] while throwing Adegan crystals on the strike team. Furthermore, he frequently used lightning attacks, most notably a powerful lightning attack called Force Explosion, as well as Dark Blast. He was also able to utilize some sort of stealth, which he combined with a lightning attack that frequently stunned his enemies.

==Behind the scenes==
Upon unlocking the Codex entry for Darth Serevin, the image displayed appears to be an image of [[Darth Kallous]].<ref name="TORC" />
If the player choses to disclose information regarding the genetic relationship between the Voss and the Gormak on Voss, Ambassador Serevin becomes enraged with the player, questioning the player's decision once the hologram transmission with the [[Three]] has terminated. After departing Serevin, the player would receive the following in-game mail from the Sith diplomat, with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] attached:
{{ExcerptIU|
Days of patient negotiations, endless gifts and delicate political manoeuvring in both Voss-Ka and Kaas City--then one sentence from you and our entire position on Voss comes crashing down. The Voss are no longer interested in discussing an alliance against the Republic and are now focused on the Gormak. I hope you are satisfied.<br /><br />The sole advantage to come out of this disaster is that the Voss Mystics seem to have warmed to us slightly in the interim. You "discovery" is spoken of with interest, as are you. I cannot possibly imagine why, but the Mystics will not be satisfied until you are furnished with a reward. In the interest of not jeopardizing our situation here further, I enclose both the gift... and a heartfelt request that you consider the Empire's future more carefully from now on.
|attrib="Recompense," from Darth Serevin
}}

On Tatooine, if the player chooses to bring in a Force-wielding Jawa rather than kill them, Serevin sends them the following message:
{{ExcerptIU|
I understand you were recently involved in the discovery of Force-sensitive Jawas. Furthermore, I understand Lord Berow attempted to conceal this new threat in a misguided attempt to uphold Sith supremacy.<br /><br /> Let me assure you that you acted wisely, and that Lord Berow will be punished when she returns to me.<br /><br /> The Empire will never triumph if we refuse to acknowledge our enemies' strengths. Power in the hands of others must be controlled, not denied.<br /><br /> You have earned my respect, perhaps we shall meet some day.
|attrib="Lord Berow and Jawa Shamans," from Darth Serevin
}}
